description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ardyn
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Awakening Darkness (0~2), removed after using Awakening Darkness two times

description.name: Awakening Darkness Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Awakening Darkness level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ardyn]

description.name: Awakening Darkness Level
description.text: Keeps track of Awakening Darkness level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ardyn]
